common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single tiny hand-inked game UI glyph for a mushroom auto-battler. Create a NEW ABSTRACT WEAPON ICON using the subject below; do not reproduce the detailed equipment sprite. STYLE REFERENCE attached: use only the mushroom's rounded extremely thick black outline and simple flat fill, do not draw a mushroom or eyes.
Style: clean flat hand-drawn cartoon pictogram. Smooth slightly organic shapes, rounded joins, VERY BOLD consistent black-green outline #0b0e09 (equivalent to 5–6 pixels at 64x64). Flat ivory #f0efdb and muted forest green #40554a; at most three colors including the outline. Broad fills, generous open negative space, no small details. This is for native 64x64 icons also displayed at 28 and 36 pixels. NOT pixel art. No gradients, lighting, shadows, highlights, paper, texture, outlines within outlines, or photorealism.
Composition: exactly ONE centered isolated compact emblem at 80% canvas extent on its longest axis, square canvas, no clipping, no words, letters, border, tile, badge, scene or character.
Background: actual transparent alpha. If alpha output is unavailable, use a SINGLE SOLID PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff chroma-key background that can be removed in asset packaging. NEVER draw a checkerboard, gray squares, simulated transparency or white backdrop.
Subject:

icons.subject: SWORD: a short broad diagonal ivory blade with a tiny dark green grip and chunky straight crossguard, very compact simple sword glyph. No inner blade lines.
SHIELD: one simple squat rounded kite shield seen head-on, ivory center, thick dark green inner rim, no rivets or decorations. A plain protection glyph.
SPEAR: one large ivory diamond spearhead on a very short dark green stem, diagonally up-right. Emphasize the arrowhead, not the shaft. No internal facet line.
BOW: one bold dark green crescent bow, with a thick straight dark string and a single short broad ivory arrow pointing right across its center. Compact archery glyph, no grip wraps.
MACE: a large simple ivory blunt lobed club head on a tiny diagonal dark green grip; only four rounded blocky lobes. Strong compact club glyph.
SICKLE: a chunky ivory crescent cutting blade curling inward with a tiny dark green grip, the open inner crescent must remain a broad empty gap. Simple harvest glyph.

GREAT SWORD: one extra-wide ivory cleaver-like sword blade with a blunt broad shoulder and triangular point, tiny dark green grip and chunky crossguard. Squat powerful sword glyph diagonally up-right, visibly wider than a regular sword, no facet lines.
GREAT SHIELD: a broad tall rounded rectangular tower shield head-on, ivory face divided by a single bold dark green vertical reinforcing stripe. Simple fortress glyph, no rivets.
GREAT SPEAR: a very broad ivory spade-shaped spearhead with two squared side shoulders and a short thick dark green stem, pointing up-right. Huge triangular head dominates, compact heavy spear glyph.
GREAT BOW: a thick double-curved dark green recurve bow shaped like a stout vertical brace, a bold string and one oversized ivory arrowhead pointing right. Compact heavy archery glyph, no ornament.
GREAT HAMMER: an enormous wide ivory rectangular hammer block on a tiny thick dark green handle, diagonal. Head takes most of the shape; heavy broad blunt silhouette. No details.

SWORD AND SHIELD: a small squat dark green kite shield with ivory center in front of one short ivory sword pointing diagonally up-right behind it. One combined compact symbol, two clear overlapping shapes, no internal fine lines.
SPEAR AND SHIELD: a squat dark green kite shield with ivory center in front of one oversized ivory diamond spearhead and a tiny stem rising up-right behind it. Combined compact symbol, no long shaft.
MACE AND SHIELD: a squat dark green kite shield with ivory center in front of a four-lobed ivory blunt mace head rising up-right behind it. Combined compact symbol, handle mostly hidden.

LANCE: a broad tapered ivory cone pointing diagonally up-right, a single chunky dark green handguard at its base and a tiny grip. A compact charge glyph with one short black motion dash behind. No long shaft, no facets.

CROSSBOW: a compact dark green T-shaped stock with broad ivory curved bow arms at the top, seen straight from above, a single ivory bolt point emerging at top-center. Distinct bold symmetric crossbow glyph, no string detail.
UMBRELLA SHIELD: a wide ivory semicircular canopy with three broad rounded scallops along the bottom and one short dark green hooked stem. Simple protective umbrella pictogram, no ribs.

SPORE MORTAR: a squat dark green U-shaped cup launcher tilted up-right, ivory thick lip, and one detached ivory spore ball immediately above it. Two simple silhouettes, cup and ball, no smoke or tiny details.

WARHAMMER: a compact ivory hammer head with one square striking face and one short triangular pick on the opposite side, on a tiny diagonal dark green grip. Clearly asymmetrical hammer-and-pick glyph.
POLEHAMMER: an ivory squared hammer head with a single short ivory spike pointing upward from its center, on a short straight dark green stem. Compact T-shaped polehammer glyph, no long shaft.

GREAT HORN: a curled dark green horn widening into a broad ivory flared mouth opening to the right, with exactly two short bold black sound-wave arcs to its right. Minimal sonic-blast glyph, no texture.
RAPIER: a narrow ivory triangular blade pointing diagonally up-right above one chunky round dark green loop guard and tiny grip. Keep the loop hole visibly open, rapier glyph, no decorative lines.
SCYTHE: a single broad ivory crescent blade sweeping left from the top of a short dark green upright stem, strong compact inverted-L silhouette. Simple reaping glyph, no long handle or extra marks.

SLING: one ivory oval stone resting in a dark green cup-shaped sling pouch with two short thick dark straps curving upward into a broad open U. Very compact stone-and-sling glyph, no thin string or extra pebbles.
